news.title: Study examines how ICHRA adoption could help stabilize ACA risk pools
news.summary: With the instability in the Affordable Care Act's marketplaces, proponents of ICHRA have suggested that these models could help support the risk pools.

news.title: Industry Voices—AI should help cancer patients survive the healthcare system
news.summary: Cancer care navigators are an invaluable resource, but there are nowhere near enough navigators to meet the scale of the need. This is where AI can make a meaningful difference, write the Digital Medicine Society's Jennifer Goldsack and former CMS Chief Medical Officer Lee Fleisher, M.D.

news.title: Insurers denied between 12% to 18% of prior authorization requests in 2025: KFF
news.summary: Researchers analyzed data from insurers in Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care and ACA Marketplace segments—representing approximately 71 million enrollees.

news.title: AHA backs HHS' voluntary 'Make Hospital Food Healthier Pledge'
news.summary: The administration is seeking voluntary commitments from hospitals to serve less processed foods in line with recently updated dietary guidelines, which officials said will boost chronic disease prevention and general long-term wellness.

news.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal case over murder of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson
news.summary: The man accused of murdering UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson has pleaded guilty in the federal trial against him, per media reports.

news.title: Patient advocacy group sues AMA for open access to CPT system
news.summary: “We are asking the court to affirm a basic principle: No one can charge the public to access standards that are incorporated into state and federal law," said PatientRightsAdvocate.org Founder Cynthia Fisher.

news.title: Weekly Rundown: US News rates GLP-1 telehealth platforms; CHAI launches AI cybersecurity work group
news.summary: Stay up to date on the latest in health tech, digital health and health AI news with this weekly brief.

news.title: Hippocratic AI rolls out platform to coordinate teams of conversational voice AI agents
news.summary: For health plans, the AI teams support functions such as member onboarding, chronic care management and Star Ratings improvement. Provider-focused offerings target patient onboarding, care gap closure and inpatient and ambulatory workflows.

news.title: Providence reports $400M operating improvement halfway through 2026
news.summary: The major nonprofit system has logged its fourth consecutive quarter of operating gains after years in the red—a key milestone for its leaders ahead of OBBBA's expected headwinds.

news.title: March of Dimes: Maternity care deserts persist, Medicaid cuts threaten to curb access further
news.summary: A number of factors contribute to access, including the availability of OB clinicians, insurance coverage and access to birthing facilities.

news.title: Major PBMs agree to offer TrumpRx pricing information to members
news.summary: The Pharmaceutical Care Management Association announced Thursday that its members had reached an agreement with the feds to offer information on cash prices available through TrumpRx.

news.title: A look at where Aetna is seeing value-based care success in Medicare Advantage
news.summary: Aetna is seeing its value-based care efforts pay off in both preventive care metrics and cost savings, according to a new analysis from the company.

news.title: Skye and Redx form new entity with $125M to advance fibrosis assets
news.summary: Skye Bioscience has entered into an agreement to combine with privately held fibrotic disease biotech Redx Pharma in a deal that will net $125 million in financing for the new public company, called Fibrx Therapeutics.

news.title: Capricor soars on plan to amend DMD filing after adcomm setback
news.summary: Capricor Therapeutics has bounced back from a bruising FDA advisory committee meeting by securing a green light to file an amendment to its approval application, raising hopes that the biotech can rescue its Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy. The biotech’s stock soared following the news.

news.title: ‘We’re not afraid of competition’: BioCryst CEO sets out strategy after scrapping internal discovery
news.summary: BioCryst CEO Charlie Gayer told Fierce the company is “not getting away from science and R&D” despite shutting down its internal discovery efforts.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—Former Legend CEO lands at K2
news.summary: Just weeks after Legend Biotech announced the departure of its CEO, Ying Huang, K2 Therapeutics has announced that Wang will now lead the startup, which was founded in 2024 with a $50 million seed round from MPM BioImpact.

news.title: MapLight dims preclinical programs to make phase 3-ready schizophrenia drug shine brighter
news.summary: Despite mixed results for its experimental schizophrenia treatment last month, MapLight Therapeutics is going all-in on the asset—at the expense of its preclinical programs.

news.title: PDS halts work on phase 3 cancer therapy to focus on colorectal contender
news.summary: PDS Biotechnology has called a halt to its phase 3 head and neck cancer therapy to channel resources to a drug in phase 2 development for metastatic colorectal cancer.

news.title: After tasting IPO success, Hemab’s CEO seeks ‘flavor of a multi-product coagulation company’
news.summary: With the post-IPO quiet period having come to an end, CEO Benny Sørensen, M.D., Ph.D., was free to sit down with Fierce to map out Hemab’s future.

news.title: Pfizer’s former chemistry whiz debuts Khartis Therapeutics with $95M for thyroid eye disease pill
news.summary: Three years after Robert Hoffman sold XinThera to Gilead, the veteran Pfizer chemist has unveiled his latest venture.

news.title: Medtronic veteran Bill Shields crosses over to become CEO at valve disease startup
news.summary: After 15 years with Medtronic’s structural heart franchise, Bill Shields is leaving the medtech giant to become the chief executive of startup Versa Vascular.

news.title: PTC’s $211M bid wins Sangamo auction, teeing up ‘special opportunity’ to enter Fabry market
news.summary: PTC Therapeutics has struck a deal to buy Sangamo Therapeutics’ Fabry disease program for $111 million upfront, outbidding Astellas and TerSera Therapeutics for the near-approval gene therapy. Sangamo, selling assets as part of its bankruptcy proceedings, also offloaded technology to Eli Lilly for $50 million.

news.title: Cullinan tees up J&J fight—and $100M payday—as Taiho-partnered drug hits phase 3 cancer goal
news.summary: Taiho Pharmaceutical and Cullinan Therapeutics have celebrated a second phase 3 victory for their small-molecule EGFR inhibitor, teeing up the partners to challenge Johnson & Johnson in a lung cancer niche.

news.title: Zealand sells its rights to Takeda’s blood cancer drug for $100M ahead of FDA approval decision
news.summary: As the FDA mulls whether to approve Takeda and Protagonist Therapeutics’ rusfertide, Zealand Pharma has sold its own rights to the blood cancer drug in return for $100 million.

papers.title: RibAssist 3D: Biplanar Rib-Fracture Detection, Addressing, and Selective 3D Localization from CT-Derived Projections
papers.summary: Rib fractures are common and time-consuming to localize on computed tomography (CT). We ask whether fractures detected independently in two orthogonal CT-derived projections (anteroposterior and lateral) can be paired across views and triangulated into reliable 3D points at a controlled rate of false outputs, and we answer it with a staged diagnostic study. papers.title: PixSDS: Why Latent SDS Makes Noisy Pixels
papers.summary: Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) enables text-to-3D generation by optimizing rendered images with a pretrained diffusion prior, but latent SDS often produces structured color artifacts and high-frequency texture noise. We identify a failure mode of latent SDS caused by VAE-induced pixel drift: the optimized image can move along pixel-space directions that are weakly constrained by the VAE encoder, so its latent representation remains clean and semantically meaningful while the image itself accumulates visible artifacts. papers.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
papers.summary: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. We characterize this futile reasoning phenomenon through systematic analysis, revealing universal capability overreach and systematic miscalibration between capability and behavior. The dominant failure mode is specious reasoning, which outputs look superficially valid but contain subtle errors, escalating with task difficulty.
